errors: Inserted SocketTest in the middle of SpannerTest, which captured SpannerTest's later methods (4 failures on the first run); moved it after the class.

First README/post draft said a wider hand closes the drum-axle window; probing showed the hand is outside the rod cage and the ratchet's own handle is what the rods stop. Corrected before commit and the test now widens the handle.

doc_friction.issue: cad test classes take ~2.5 min each to build parts; '-k' runs of test_cad.py outlast the 120 s foreground timeout, so start them in the background from the outset.

goal: Deepen flagship open-tennis-robots: the last open buildable CAD item.
notes: guide.socket_checks: deep socket + 0-250 mm bars + ratchet + hand along each nut's axis at every hole when its step comes; bolt tail must fit the socket bore. 15 nut joints: 12 take a bare socket+ratchet, drum axle nut turns with a ratchet between rods (15 deg, marginal), flight-cap M3 nyloc takes no socket, levelling jam nut needs a deep socket (26.8 mm tail). No nut needs an extension. Report only (not a pass/fail). Packages regenerated. Verification: tests/test_cad.py SocketTest + SpannerTest (see PR), validate.py, check_posts.py.
